items.headline: CoreWeave 2027 debt payments jump 77% to ~$11B, 10-Q shows; total debt $47.5B
items.note: Undrawn facility headroom fell to $5.7B from $10.0B while near-term maturities rose sharply, tightening neocloud refinancing capacity.

items.headline: CoreWeave rules out unsecured debt at current yields, plans $4B+ investment-grade loan
items.note: Parent-level unsecured funding is effectively shut at current yields; the company relies on customer-backed secured loans whose final terms are not yet set.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley trims data-center loan exposure, shifts risk to private credit
items.note: Bank risk transfer of data-center construction loans signals reduced bank appetite and more reliance on private credit.
